data.name: Dungeon Dash: Relic Of Binding
data.detailed_description:
Dungeon Dash — Relic of Binding

Part puzzle. Part adventure. All roguelike.

A violent earthquake shakes the depths of the ancient dungeon, sending the Relic of Binding tumbling from its resting place, releasing monsters of chaos and destruction from their sealed tomb. Carried by an underground stream, the relic washes ashore at the dungeon's entrance. Now it waits.

But the Relic of Binding does not wait passively. The hero who takes it up will find themselves bound to its power and bound to its purpose. There is no setting it down. There is no turning back. The relic must be returned to its sanctum, and it has chosen you to carry it there.

Which hero has the courage and cunning to venture back into the darkness, face what has been unleashed, and return the Relic of Binding to its sanctum before the chaos spreads beyond the dungeon forever?

The Relic Changes Everything

The Relic of Binding is no ordinary treasure. Possessing it grants its bearer incredible power, but power that must be understood before it can be mastered.

Move fast enough and you enter the Dash State, a blur of unstoppable momentum that makes you invincible and obliterates any monster in your path. The relic rewards the bold, the fast, and the clever. But its power has boundaries. Master them and the dungeon is yours. Ignore them and the dungeon will remind you who is really in charge.

Every room is a carefully constructed puzzle of walls, corridors, monsters, and traps, designed to challenge your ability to navigate the relic's power rather than fight against it. The hero who learns to think in straight lines will find the Relic of Binding an unstoppable force. The hero who doesn't will find the dungeon a very short experience.

No Two Dungeons. No Excuses.

Dungeon Dash doesn't rely on algorithms to keep things fresh. Every level is hand-crafted with the care and precision that puzzle design demands, built by human hands to challenge, surprise, and reward clever thinking. With hundreds of meticulously designed levels drawn randomly every run, no two dungeons are ever the same.

You get the creative depth of a designed puzzle and the endless variety of a roguelike. Every time.

data.short_description: The Relic of Binding has chosen you. Navigate puzzles, battle monster hordes, and hunt for treasure through a dungeon that never plays the same way twice. Master the relic's power, beat the clock, and return it to its sanctum before the darkness spreads forever.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Dual Core 2.0 GHz
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DX11-capable GPU with 512 MB VRAM
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 11.0 (Big Sur)
  • Processor: Apple M1 or Intel Core i3 @ 2.0 GHz
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Metal-capable GPU
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04 (64-bit) or equivalent
  • Processor: Dual Core 2.0 GHz (64-bit)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3.3+ or Vulkan 1.1+ GPU
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
